visual_text: Dentures: out at night, cleaned every day
In a Japanese study of people aged 85 and over living at home, sleeping in dentures was linked with more admissions to hospital with pneumonia, or deaths from it. A link does not show cause.
In hospital: tell the ward staff you wear dentures
In hospital: keep them in a denture pot
In hospital: check they are not left on a tray
Iinuma et al., J Dent Res 2015; McReynolds et al., J Prosthodont 2023
alt_text: Checklist card with a drawing of a bedside table holding a lamp, glasses, a denture pot and a glass of water. Dentures: out every night, cleaned every day, stored as the dentist advises. In hospital: tell staff, use a denture pot, check they are not left on a tray. A Japanese study found a link with pneumonia, not proof of cause.
